notes: shitpaper (SHITPAPER): fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 * 1e18 minted once to the deployer (the launch factory); no owner, no admin functions, no minting after launch. A 3% fee applies only to ERC-20 transfers out of the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (buys) and is deducted from what the buyer receives; transfers to the PoolManager (sells, the pool seed) and wallet-to-wallet transfers pay nothing. Fees stay in the token contract and are distributed pro rata to eligible holders before the buyer's net amount is credited; holders claim with claim(), anyone can pay a holder out with claimFor(address). The PoolManager, the token contract, 0x...dEaD and the launch's Merkle distributor (read from factory.distributorOf(launchNumber) at transfer time) are excluded from dividends. Pool paired with IMD at 1.25% fee, tick spacing 60; 90% of the supply seeds the pool, 10% goes to the swarm via the factory's Merkle distributor, the remainder to 0x...dead. initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from the economics.
